horoscopes.horoscope: Today, you are not in your usual gregarious mood. An unpleasant situation may also prove to be a challenge. Even though you’re enterprising, Ganesha suggests that you don’t go tripping all over yourself. A little devotion to God can make a big difference to your life. You may be in a long distance relationship with an online friend. An exchange of heartfelt greetings via e-mail or SMS is going to rev up your love life. Try to surprise your loved one by turning as much creative as possible. Even romantic affairs may lead to a blissful marriage. Ganesha feels that because the day is going to remain tricky for you, it will be good to postpone important assignments. It’s a day to recharge yourself with the activities that you like. Don’t take too much strain, else you will drain. In financial matters, you will not need to struggle much as the stars will be in your favour. If you can use your commercial instincts more efficiently, you will be able to earn extra money. You will feel determined to achieve all your pending tasks. As the day progresses, confusion may fog your judgment and thought process. Clarify your doubts from your superior and be confident. As a result, you tend to be indecisive and biased in following an appropriate method, feels Ganesha.

Never dig a well when your house is on fire, says Ganesha. You will realise the importance of saving money for future needs today. You will feel uneasy in your routine and may feel the urge to get away from the chaos of things. Evening might see you spend a small fortune on loved ones and leisure, predicts Ganesha. A lovely evening is ahead with your partner, foresees Ganesha. You will feel comfortable in the company of your better half. Surprising your sweetheart is in your mind. Reading out romantic poems to your lover, chocolates or roses would be the glorious idea to set a sensual atmosphere. You will need to stay fit and fine by keeping your mood swings in control. You are suggested to take vitamins and necessary food to maintain good health. The day is going to be stressful enough for you to handle it. Ganesha feels that you will be practical while purchasing things. You will be able to negotiate well if you have to buy something. This is the right time to take a call on the purchase of expensive items. Today your pragmatic approach will make your presentation skill a more appealing and confident. Your communication skills will help you do well in meetings. Ganesha feels these meetings might change your perception of other people’s abilities. You will earn appreciation for your concern.

You are likely to have a great time with like-minded people, says Ganesha. At work, achieving perfection will be your motto. You will strive for perfection at work and home. You will remain practical and pragmatic throughout the day. Your jolly and playful nature will please your lover tonight. You will turn flirtatious with your signature sense of humour. Jokes and fun-filled activities will surely create a wonderful mood this evening. Avoid being too garrulous tonight as your partner may not appreciate or feel sensitive, warns Ganesha. Ganesha feels that you are likely to remain confused from morning till afternoon. You should try to focus your mind on a single task, and avoid diverting your energy in the wrong direction. Don’t waste your time after futile activities. Early in the day there shall be some huge expenses, but most of it will be on things which are really not necessary for you at this stage. Besides, these things may not bring luck to you. The first half of the day will see you in a playful mood. You are likely to spend some fruitful hours with the colleagues at the canteen or at the meeting room. It will be only later that you will get on to some serious work, says Ganesha.

Though the day will spring a lot of challenges, you will be up to it every single time. Your mind will be sharp, and will run like an athlete taking part in a marathon. All you need is a little self-belief. And there will be no stopping you once you set your mind free. You may experiment with the interiors of your house. Tension hovers around your love life as your mate doubts your integrity. You are even likely to get caught up in a fight with your lover. Be honest and trustworthy with your partner, warns Ganesha. The tension will fade away if you try to get closer with your sweetheart. In the first half of the day, your health is likely to remain stable. You will not be using your emotional energy in taking decisions, instead your approach will remain practical. In the second half, you should avoid wasting energy in over-communication. Your financial decisions during the second half of the day may not be very sound so you should avoid thinking much about money matters and try to put your mind into something else, feels Ganesha. You may depend on your luck today. You are waiting for your lucky charm to work wonders for you. Hence, Ganesha advises you to avoid all important tasks today. Avoid making major decisions too. Be practical as it helps you achieve most of your pending tasks.

It is fine to make hay while the sun shines, but do not forget to put aside some for a rainy day as well, says Ganesha. Today is one such day when you can do fantastically well by putting aside some money for your family’s future. At work, pending tasks may have piled up, but today you shall do well to try and clear the backlog. Everything said, do not forget to take a break from the routine, says Ganesha. Evening promises to be passionate!. Share everything with your loved one whatever is in your mind. Even if you have done any mistake, reveal it to your sweetheart. He or she will forgive you when you are truly honest. You will have a wonderful evening in the company of your loved one. Your mind will be occupied with positive thoughts, right from the moment you get up in the morning. As a result, you shall easily complete all the challenging tasks. Pending work on the personal front will also be accomplished today. You are likely to witness a lot of activity on the financial front early in the day today. Ganesha feels that if you desire to implement your ideas, you should do so in the first half of the day. Technical errors bug you a lot; the same may happen today. Use your powers of reasoning to solve all your problems, says Ganesha. You may not know everything but learning from your peers will help you come out of the trouble, feels Ganesha.

Your position of strength will be shaken badly today. All chances are, this may invite unwanted troubles and furrow deeper lines of worry. But you may yet do good if you shift out of the usual and foray into something new. Striking the right balance between work and family is the need of the hour as there are chances that your loved one may feel ignored. You need to keep in touch with your spouse to make him or her feel how committed you are. Look forward to a great day. Your body will be filled with lots of energy, and your mind shall be full of brilliant ideas. As a result, things which appear to be difficult for others, you shall accomplish, very easily. Financial affairs are going to be a matter of deep concern for you today, which are not quite reasonable as your financial situation will be pretty sound and you ought to feel secure. A favourable day awaits you, foresees Ganesha. Work will go smoothly. You will be able to solve complex issues by applying yourself logically. You may call for a meeting post lunch and tell everyone to express logical ideas. Your important suggestions might be lauded by your seniors.

To be or not to be? Well, that may not be your precise state of mind, but Ganesha does see possibilities of you being puzzled and perplexed today when it comes to professional issues. Chances are that in the afternoon, you may happen to run into an unpleasant situation, so just keep your cool. In any case, things shall get better by the evening. The latter part of the day is favourable, so go ahead and express you long-cherished love for that special someone, says Ganesha. You will be on the cloud nine tonight as you are likely to get sweet compliments from your loved one. Give a special gift to your sweetheart so as to make him or her feel strongly attached. Celebrate each moment with your sweetheart to foster romantic bliss, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you will begin this boring day, feeling very uneasy and lazy. You should therefore refrain from starting anything new, on all the fronts of life. Just avoid shifting your residence or buying a vehicle, as far as possible. Unwanted expenses during the first half of the day are going to cause you a lot of stress today, predicts Ganesha. Besides, medical expenses will only aggravate the situation. Today you will be the centre of attention in the office, foresees Ganesha. You will be an expert in a subject matter. Your colleagues will come to you for help and you will be pleased to extend your support. This will motivate you to solve complex issues with ease.

Business will keep you on your toes and make you dance around, says Ganesha. Success is likely to intoxicate you. Ganesha advises you not to let emotions influence your plans and strategies in any way. It’s the time to show your ability to compromise. Ganesha would like to quote a Scottish saying, “Better bend than break”. If things don’t work your way, stay together and build a better understanding. A glass of red wine will surely bring a great mood to ignite passion. Today, you will have to accept that everything cannot happen in a day. Be patient and try to keep some tasks for tomorrow too. As it is, today, you are not going to achieve your targets even if you try very hard. You may slow down on expenses in the second half of the day as compared to the first half. Thus, you will spend lesser if you go out shopping in the latter part of the day. Start the day with power-packed yogas and you will get relief at the end of the day. You may feel slightly disheartening. You will have to rack your brains over difficult matters. Constant hurdles and challenges will eventually make you stronger, inspires Ganesha.

High-octane action might be in the offing at work today. The day will be highlighted by your workaholic and tireless nature. Your bosses may be lenient with you today on certain issues. Love, affection and devotion of your loved ones will keep you preoccupied otherwise. A great relief on the love front! Emotional bonds with the opposite sex will become stronger. You will easily attract your new love and will be able to arouse the flavour of romance. Now, boost your confidence to strengthen the pillar of relationship, inspires Ganesha. You will be required to maintain good health by taking vitamin rich food and other foods to maintain good health. There are more chances of you facing troubles in the future if you do not take care of your health today. Ganesha does not foresee major financial problems during the first half of the day. Besides, you may think of taking family members out for an entertainment program or dinner party in the evening. A challenging time is on the cards professionally. Ganesha feels that important tasks may get stuck in the pipeline. Only time will solve all your problems. You will smoothly work on the familiar tasks. Be dedicated and enjoy the natural course of action, says Ganesha.

Striking a perfect balance between work and passion, you are likely to inspire people and leave them in awe with all that multitasking, says Ganesha. Of course, as the day progresses, work will gain more prominence and demand more attention, but for the time being, you will enjoy the break you may get from work. Amid all the happenings, your social life may take a back-seat, but you wouldn’t as much as even realise it. You may not be happy in your current relationship or expect a future uncertainty. Emotional stress in the matters of love will keep you and your loved one in a disturbed mood. Understanding and sharing joys and difficulties with each other are the keys to making your love life safe, feels Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you shall calmly and patiently handle tricky situations on all the fronts. This will help you to divert your energy in the right direction. Besides, you shall properly plan your daily schedule and easily accomplish your tasks. Speculation will be the order of the day, feels Ganesha, and moreover, this is a favourable day for such activities. However, exercise care, and do not go all out recklessly. You seem to be very confident today and would like to take a bold approach. However, important decisions must be put on hold today, feels Ganesha. In case you still go ahead, you might have to rectify them later. Taking views from others or discussing with experts will pacify your mind.

Metaphysics and philosophy have aroused your interest. Instead of spending a huge amount on books on these subjects, Ganesha suggests that you keep a balanced approach and practice spiritual discipline. It’s also high time you changed your dietary habits. Since you are feeling lucky, you might act dramatically in front of your loved one which, no doubt, will amuse him/her. You would like to surprise your lover with some amazing gifts. Both of you will have a blissful evening ahead. Since morning you will be in a very good mood. You shall therefore prefer to enjoy this wonderful day with your near and dear ones. Book movie tickets for the evening show or have dinner at a multi-cuisine restaurant. Today is an auspicious day for buying property or a vehicle. You will be happy with your selection, as it will suit your needs perfectly. You may also think of buying items of creature comforts. Stars are in your favour today. Creativity and innovation will come to you naturally, says Ganesha. You will meet many people and come across many exciting new ideas. You tend to be experimental and are likely to achieve good results, foresees Ganesha.

You will be in the mood to splurge today. You are likely to find yourself throwing a party or entertaining guests in the afternoon. You might just indulge in some uncalled-for extravagance and give your spouse a pleasant, albeit expensive, surprise, says Ganesha. You may be submissive and compromising. Ganesha thinks this is the right attitude to make your loved one happy. Taking your sweetheart to an unusual place or sharing a funny moment at home will surely boost his/her spirit, feels Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that your mood may swing in two different directions today. You may get confused, as your mind is likely to wander far and wide. To remain focussed on all the fronts, you are advised to practice yoga or meditation. Today though you shall be spending money, you will not be too pre-occupied with financial matters. Besides, you will avoid spending on unnecessary things, which will add to your savings. It seems that your mind is occupied with so many things. You may be indecisive about the right projects. If you are not in a mood to take up a task, don’t do it, suggests Ganesha. If you still go ahead, you might mess it up completely.
